scope: Authorized bounded shadow-only extension to WS4; no new simulator

physical_constraints_if_unblocked: one shared game weather realization for both teams
closed roof has zero outdoor exposure

promotion_rule: None in this ticket; PR 130 stays unmerged; no betting recommendations
rollback_rule: Remove only the new audit code/sidecar; original forecasts and production files never modified
